main_finding: A frozen ROBDD-to-dDNNF Shannon translation carried local determinism/decomposability certificates and preserved exact semantics under every tested ASSIGN transition. Cross-language switching can therefore be made proof-carrying on this bounded corpus.
cost_lesson: The structural translation was small, but exhaustive exact finite semantic verification dominated the paid ledger. Translation and certification must remain distinct complexity terms.
next_objective: Attack the portfolio admission controller with repeated or intrinsically expensive representation switches. Measure cumulative compile/translate/verify work and reject any claim that small snapshots imply polynomial trajectory cost.
